## Problem

What network operation is difficult or slow today?

## Proposed solution

Describe the tool or change you would like. If you are proposing a new MCP tool,
include:

- Tool name and purpose
- Inputs (device, command, options)
- Whether it is read-only or changes device state
- The pyATS or Genie API it would use

## Example prompt

The natural-language prompt an engineer would type in Copilot Chat:

> ...

## Safety considerations

If the tool changes device state, describe the guardrails it needs.

## Alternatives considered

Anything you have already tried or ruled out.
